description: An HTML file that includes a script defining a Calculator class extending Service, which registers methods 'add' and 'sub' for remote invocation, and initializes a service manager to connect to a server and register the Calculator service.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A class extending Service that implements 'add' and 'sub' methods for remote invocation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an array of numbers and returns the sum as a Promise.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Subtracts the second parameter from the first and returns the result as a Promise.
